title: Cousances Doufeu Cast Iron Casserole – Brown – Made in France – Vintage Dutch Oven
description:
Beautiful vintage Cousances Doufeu cast iron casserole in classic brown enamel. Cousances is the historic French cookware brand that was later acquired by Le Creuset, and these pieces are well known for their excellent quality and durability.
The Doufeu design is a traditional French casserole made for slow cooking and even heat distribution, perfect for stews, braising, roasting, and slow-cooked dishes. The heavy enameled cast iron retains heat beautifully and can be used on the stovetop or in the oven.
Details:
• Brand: Cousances
• Model: Doufeu casserole / Dutch oven
• Material: Enameled cast iron
• Color: Brown exterior with cream interior
• Made in France
• Two side handles and matching lid
Condition:
Good vintage condition with normal signs of use. The interior enamel remains in good usable condition. The small mark visible near the rim is not a chip but paint transfer from fabric. Please see photos for details.
A wonderful piece of classic French cookware, ideal for collectors, home chefs, or anyone who appreciates vintage enameled cast iron.
